cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Hide this envelope under the picnic hamper before Mum comes in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked me to unpack the hamper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then keep the envelope in your pocket while you unpack.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll end up taking it home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. I'll explain when she stops asking where it is.

mechanism: A manages concealment as a precise handover, correcting B disclosure and conspicuous handling to keep Mum from seeing the envelope.
confusable: Ordinary secrecy alone would accept any hiding place; S03 must correct the helper response while retaining control.
comparison: Family-table concealment differs from the other alternative's shared-home key access.
seedUse: Use the envelope and Mum seed; replace generic professionalism with corrections to B's actual concealment choices.
